Follow, download and cancel an export

Source: R/exports.R
soil_export_status.Rd

soil_export_status() reads the state of an export once (GET /exports/{job_id}). soil_export_wait() polls it every poll seconds until it ends: a completed export is returned; a failed or cancelled export, an unknown job id (the API answers status = "unknown" for an id it does not know, e.g. an expired export) or an export still running after timeout seconds is a soilhub_job_error with the last state in e$job and e$reason (failed, cancelled, unknown_job, timeout). soil_export_download() streams the zip of a completed export to <dir>/<job_id>.zip (the server's name) and unzips it into <dir>/<job_id>/; existing files are never replaced unless overwrite = TRUE. An export is kept 7 days after submission (expires_at): a later download is a soilhub_not_found_error. soil_export_cancel() asks the API to stop an export that has not ended (POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel); the worker stops at its next heartbeat.

Usage

soil_export_status(soil = soil_session(), x)

soil_export_wait(
  soil = soil_session(),
  x,
  timeout = 3600,
  poll = 5,
  progress = interactive()
)

soil_export_download(
  soil = soil_session(),
  x,
  dir = NULL,
  unzip = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  progress = interactive()
)

soil_export_cancel(soil = soil_session(), x)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

x

A soil_export or a job id ("exp_<stamp>_<hex>"). API path parameter {job_id} of GET /exports/{job_id}, GET /exports/{job_id}/download and POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel.

timeout

Seconds to wait before giving up (default one hour). Client-side: not sent to the API.

poll

Seconds between two polls (at least 2). Client-side: not sent to the API.

progress

Show the progress (a bar in an interactive session, else one message per change). Client-side: not sent to the API.

dir

Directory of the download; NULL uses the option soilhub.export_dir, the environment variable SOILHUB_EXPORT_DIR, else file.path(tempdir(), "soilhub-exports"). Client-side: not sent to the API.

unzip

Unzip the download into <dir>/<job_id>/. Client-side: not sent to the API.

overwrite

Replace an existing zip or directory of the same export. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

soil_export_status(), soil_export_wait(), soil_export_download(): the updated soil_export (see soil_export()). soil_export_cancel(): the job after the request (a soil_job, see soil_job()).

Details

The job id is the only handle on an export (the API lists no exports), so each function accepts the soil_export returned by soil_export() or the job id alone, also in a later R session.

Rights: soil:read; soil_export_cancel() needs soil:publish (the API controls every job through the unified job registry, which needs that right).

See also

Other exports: soil_export(), soil_export_from_error(), soil_export_read()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- soil_export(soil, datasets = "wosis_points", wait = FALSE)
soil_export_status(soil, x)$status
x <- soil_export_wait(soil, x, timeout = 1800)
x <- soil_export_download(soil, x, dir = "exports")
x$files

# in a later session, from the id alone
x <- soil_export_download(soil, "exp_20261019_101500_1a2b3c4d")
} # }
